name: Sigil of Trollbane
summary: The Sigil of Trollbane is held by Prince Galen Trollbane in Stromgarde. It is the last sigil needed to open Thoras Trollbane’s tomb and claim Trol’kalar.

sections.title: The Last Sigil
sections.body: Zengu in Hammerfall seeks the final sigil, which Prince Galen keeps within Stromgarde. Galen lives in a chapel in the militia-held district and is well protected. Bring the sigil to Zengu, and the way to Thoras Trollbane’s tomb can be opened.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of Trollbane for?
faq.answer: The Sigil of Trollbane is the final sigil needed to open Thoras Trollbane’s tomb and claim Trol’kalar.

faq.q: Who has the Sigil of Trollbane?
faq.answer: Prince Galen Trollbane holds the Sigil of Trollbane in Stromgarde.

faq.q: Where can I find Prince Galen?
faq.answer: Prince Galen resides in a chapel in the militia-held district of Stromgarde.
Zengu in Hammerfall seeks the Sigil of Trollbane.

faq.q: What comes after the sigils are gathered?
faq.answer: With the sigils in hand, Zengu plans to strike against the trolls of Zul’Gurub and take Trol’kalar from Thoras Trollbane’s tomb.

angles.text: As a warrior, you may find Prince Galen a fitting guardian for the last sigil; he is himself a seasoned fighter.
